name: bizplug-hr-comms
description: The hr & internal comms plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a platform demo. It works from the business's own published profile, covering policies, benefits and who to contact, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Book a platform demo for hr & internal comms businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls find_demo_slots and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Where do I find the benefits policy, and who handles PTO?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_demo only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
